label: Task-4
title: Deploy GitHub Pages and DNS for news.issuesFS.ai
description: Set up the infrastructure for the Journalist news site at news.issuesFS.ai. Tasks: (1) Create .github/workflows/deploy-site.yml in Journalist repo with path-filtered trigger (publications/**, _config.yml, _layouts/**, _includes/**, assets/**, index.md, index.html, feed*.xml, _data/**) on push to main. Use actions/jekyll-build-pages and actions/deploy-pages. (2) Enable GitHub Pages on Issues-FS__Dev__Role__Journalist repo (source: GitHub Actions). (3) Add CNAME file with news.issuesFS.ai. (4) Configure DNS: CNAME record for news.issuesFS.ai pointing to owasp-sbot.github.io. (5) Verify SSL provisioning. See ADR-001 and ADR-002 in Architect repo for full spec.
